items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I took you know, like Joe Barufaldi, Ricky Nelson - a guy named Pruitt on bass and it was a great band

ctx.x: And, so, all those guys were doing the same and that's exactly what they're doing now and in the beginning - I went to California on a couple of occasions and I took you know, like Joe Barufaldi, Ricky Nelson - a guy named Pruitt on bass and it was a great band and we worked at a place called the Hang-Over--
